purpose: Exploratory validation-only accuracy study after the frozen measurement follow-up. No test metric may select a configuration; any later test result is disclosed as exploratory because this test split was previously inspected.
selection_metric: validation AUROC, averaged across the three training seeds; accuracy is reported as a secondary validation metric
interpretation: This investigates optimization/capacity, not a new quantum algorithm. Fidelity must outperform the same-recipe dot control to support a kernel-specific claim.
